recipes.name: Broccoli Cheese Layer Bake
ingredients_raw: 2 (11 ounce) cans condensed cream of Cheddar cheese soup
2 (10.75 ounce) cans condensed cream of chicken soup

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Cook broccoli in boiling salted water until tender.
Mix cheese and chicken soups in a large bowl. Add 2 cups of croutons; blend together well. Drain broccoli.

In a 15x10x2 inch baking pan, place half the cooked broccoli in a layer. Spoon half the soup mixture over the broccoli. Finish with a second layer of broccoli and top vegetable with remaining soup mix. Cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 30 minutes or until bubbling.

raw_recipe.headline: Broccoli Cheese Layer Bake
raw_recipe.description: This is a recipe we have enjoyed in my family for several years. It has become a holiday staple and is very easy to make. In fact, it tastes better the next day or just cold out of the refrigerator.

review.reviewBody: This was good, but I did make some small changes. I only used 1 can each of the soups. I stirred everything together in a large bowl before adding to baking dish, topped with shredded cheddar before baking. Everyone enjoyed it.

This was an easy and quick recipe to make. I used fresh broccoli and steamed it and then let it drain and cool. I added only 1 can of cheddar soup with the 2 cans of cream of chicken. I mixed the broccoli, soups, and croutons all together. I sprayed my casserole with Pam and put all the ingredients in and topped the casserole with shredded cheddar cheese. It turned out wonderful! Thx!

My family and I really love this dish. I have made it twice now. First time was exactly as written. Delicious side dish but had a little much sauce. Next time, was exactly as is with 2lbs of cubed cooked chicken mixed in. This went from a side dish to the main entree and was really, really good. If you are commenting on a "processed" taste, please read the ingredients before making and reviewing. Thank you for a wonderful recipe!

I made this for my family and day care kids and everyone loved it! The only thing I did was added some cut up chicken breast to it. Totally easy to make and well worth it. Adding it to my list of dinners for sure!

Our family enjoyed this, but with a few changes. I used only 1 can of each soup. Next time, will omit croutons entirely- we all felt that they were ok, but not something we would want again. The sauce (halved) was perfect with the broccoli.

My Family did not like this recipe, nor did I. It was overkill on the cheese sauce and it tasted like it had too many preservatives in it, even though I used Fresh Broccoli instead of Frozen. I will make my own version, using my cheese sauce recipe, (from my Mac and Cheese Recipe) and fresh Broccoli. A Sprinkle of Parmesan on top will make it perfect. I will submit the recipe as soon as I get it set up.
Pretty good. I used Stove Top Canister stuffing crumbs and they didn't get soggy at all. Excellent for last minute pot-lock and when you don't want to spend a lot of money or invest a lot of time.
Didn’t make any changes. Very bland and boring. Maybe add croutons just on top instead of mixing in.
very easy, hearty for broccoli lovers and kid friendly, thank U!
My boys and boyfriend really liked this recipe! I just blanched the broccoli and added more croutons. :) yum
This was very easy to make and tasty! I omitted the croutons because others said they turned out soggy. It was very soupy, which I liked, but some people might not.
Try Broccoli Chicken Casserole 1 on this website, sort by most helpful, and follow reviewers' suggestions. It's way yummy.
I made this during the holidays as something a little different to serve as a side. I wish I hadn't. No one at it :-(

Very disappointed. There was far too much sauce, as well as it being bland and "fake cheese" tasting. It made for a bland, soggy mess. While the general idea behind this recipe sounded good, I don't know if it can be made so, and I have no interest in trying.
WONDERFUL!!! perfect for family dinner or big gatherings.
It was good. I used broccoli florets - next time I will use chopped as stated in the recipe. I am sure that would make it better.
